maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Wall Tile Paving Robot (墙砖铺贴机器人)
name: Bright Dream wall tile paving robot
summary: Autonomous indoor robot that applies thin-bed tile adhesive and sets 300 × 450-600 mm wall tiles in flats, offices, hotels and malls. Made by Country Garden's robotics arm Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Functions
specs.value: navigation, positioning, path planning, adhesive application and tile setting
specs.quote: 通过自主导航、定位、路径规划、自动涂胶和铺贴墙砖的功能

specs.label: Time per tile
specs.conditions: press report from the Shantou pilot
specs.quote: 不到一分钟就贴好了一块瓷砖

notes: A separate tile-loading robot refills tiles; a worker refills the adhesive (Shantou pilot).
Mechanism and drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.

images.alt: Bright Dream wall tile paving robot

evidence.task: Set wall tiles on its own in a multi-robot fit-out system run from BIM and fleet software
evidence.where: Country Garden Jinping project, Shantou, China
evidence.note: Acceptance of the multi-robot system on 30 December 2021; a worker fills the adhesive and a loading robot adds tiles.
